events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` `#mobile-toggle` has `aria-label` but no `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, and `public/app.js` never closes the menu after an in-page link is clicked.

## What to do

1. Add `aria-controls="mobile-menu" aria-expanded="false"` and update it in app.js.
2. Close the menu on link click and on Escape.
3. Add a contract test in `tests/test_frontend_mock_ui.py`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `aria-expanded` reflects state
- [ ] Clicking a link closes the menu
- [ ] Test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-timer-web
```
